purpose: Machine-readable index of Repair 4 registered domains and architectural roles. This file does not define new ESRM wire semantics.

reconciliation_algebra.notes: Mutually exclusive ESRM reconciliation meanings; this index does not add wire encoding.

target_capability_classes.notes: Recovery class must be supported by committed target-capability evidence and cannot be acquired by adapter self-declaration.

dispatch_lifecycle_terms.notes: Lifecycle terminology extracted for architecture/test traceability; this file does not define a replacement state-machine schema.

global_safety_properties.statement: Cryptographic validity is not authority validity and authority validity is not empirical validity.
Consumed authority remains consumed even when the external effect did not occur or cannot be established.
Unknown external effect status must not be converted by inference into success, failure, or restored authority.

Automatic same-effect retransmission requires verified durable idempotency for the same effect identity and canonical payload; otherwise recovery requires a new transition/new authority or remains unresolved.
Absence of observed evidence does not establish evidence of absence without authoritative closed-world coverage.
Settlement requires independently distinguishable committed evidence roles and may not be established by executor claim alone.

non_normative_role_classes.name: SPECULATIVE
non_normative_role_classes.basis: Repair 4 preserves SPECULATIVE != EMPIRICAL != ADJUDICATED in section 40; this architecture label groups proposal/derived material without creating new wire semantics.

non_normative_role_classes.name: EMPIRICAL
non_normative_role_classes.basis: Repair 4 section 40 distinguishes empirical validity and section 31 says reconciliation conclusions are adjudicated, not empirical evidence.

non_normative_role_classes.name: ADJUDICATED
non_normative_role_classes.basis: Repair 4 section 31 assigns reconciliation conclusions to the ADJUDICATED domain.

non_normative_role_classes.name: SETTLED
non_normative_role_classes.basis: Repair 4 section 40 defines the evidence conditions required for SETTLED(tau).

change_control.rule: Any future field, schema, domain, artifact type, or invariant not frozen in Repair 4 must be classified as an implementation requirement, deployment profile requirement, commercial product requirement, or proposed future ESRM extension before use.
